# Notes

## Week 1: 6/23-6/26

### Mon 6/23

- Met with Prof. Everbach to check in, layout direction for project.

- Checked in with J

  - J gone on wed 6/25

  - Need to familiarize myself with the lathe here

  - Plan on machining linkages tue 6/24 and thu 6/26

- Hope to finish linkages by next week so I can start assembly of the front frame

- Need more bolts

![](media/image4.jpg){width="6.5in" height="4.875in"}

- Getting this three-member joint to lay flat seems like may be an issue. I should make sure everything is in line before I start making more linkages.

  - Nora informed me that washers were used before, but I think it would be good to have a design that doesn't need them.

- I decided to make a model of the front section in Fusion to help me to figure out how to alter the linkage:

![](media/image1.png){width="3.0in" height="3.585in"}

- This was a good exercise as it was my first time modeling with multiple components. I will ask Nora if turning this into a full model of the car is of interest. If so, I may work on this when I don't have mechanical work to do.

- Instead of altering the 3D printed part, I filed down a side of the linkage so that the whole joint lies flat:

![](media/image7.jpg){width="4.0in" height="3.0030774278215224in"}

- Need for front:

  - 18 end members

  - 2 two-sided members (or three if the off-center hole is a problem)

<!-- -->

- Need for back:

### Tue 6/24

- Spent the day machining stopper linkages in the shop.

  - For the first couple hours, I familiarized myself with the lathe and other tools

- I managed to make 7, 9 more to go.

<!-- -->

- I went up to SH124 to assemble as much of the chassis as I could:

![](media/image6.jpg){width="6.5in" height="4.875in"}

### Wed 6/25

- Machined more stopper linkages in the shop. Managed to make five more.

  - Discovered that the threads needed to be tapped deeper, and the ½" relief at the top had to be bored out from ⅜" to 25/64". This way, the tap was able to make it through.

- Attended pizza lunch & talk.

- Assembled more of the chassis with new linkages; screws still not going in far enough after tapping deeper. Not sure why.

### Thu 6/26

- I decided to take a break from machining linkages because it was getting very tiresome.

- I re-assembled part of the chassis with the new linkages:

<!-- -->

- For the rest of the day, I continued to work on the Fusion model of the car. There were several hiccups that I still haven't found solutions to.

![](media/image3.png){width="5.588542213473316in" height="3.9854188538932633in"}
